question: Does causally observed early Pump pre-graduation non-curve holder concentration add signal-quality information beyond Participant Quality and existing flow evidence?

feature_contract.definition: At a read-only snapshot requested no earlier than T0+3s and completed by T0+5s, aggregate Helius getTokenAccounts raw balances by owner for the mint, exclude the decoded Pump bonding_curve owner, divide each remaining owner balance by exact getTokenSupply raw total supply, and sum squared owner supply shares.
feature_contract.denominator_policy: exact raw total supply from getTokenSupply; never rebase to tradeable float or remaining non-curve supply
feature_contract.owner_aggregation_policy: sum all token-account raw amounts for the same owner before HHI
feature_contract.market_owner_exclusion_policy: exclude the decoded Pump bonding_curve owner; if a PumpSwap create-pool event for the same mint is causally observed before snapshot request, feature is MISSING rather than guessing pool-vault ownership
feature_contract.pagination_policy: getTokenAccounts limit=1000; continue pages until a page returns fewer than 1000 rows; incomplete pagination by cutoff is MISSING

directional_read.next_step_if_sufficient: mechanism/robustness review then define/freeze a separate fresh-confirmation hypothesis
directional_read.next_step_if_insufficient: report insufficient sample; do not extend/repeat based on observed outcome
